answer: I would anchor trust in Signed gaming account history with publisher attestation. With an account the publisher kept across years of play, a single jade check quietly prices out anyone trying to run a hundred names at once. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since an account the publisher kept across years of play takes calendar time as well as money — and the prism is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the jetty of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head.
